verses.1: Unto the end. In verses, the understanding of David,
verses.2: when the Ziphites had arrived and they said to Saul, “Has not David been hidden with us?”
verses.3: Save me, O God, by your name, and judge me in your virtue.
verses.4: O God, listen to my prayer. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.
verses.5: For strangers have risen up against me, and the strong have sought my soul. And they have not set God before their eyes.
verses.6: For behold, God is my helper, and the Lord is the protector of my soul.
verses.7: Turn back the evils upon my adversaries, and ruin them by your truth.
verses.8: I will freely sacrifice to you, and I will confess your name, O God, because it is good.
verses.9: For you have quickly rescued me from all tribulation, and my eye has looked down upon my enemies. [ Psalm 54 ] (55)
